id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation. Required if you have multiple busses.

*See also: [OpenTherm](https://esphome.io/components/opentherm#configuration-variables)*

in_pin.docs:
**number**: The pin of the OpenTherm hardware bridge which is usually labeled `out` on the board.

*See also: [OpenTherm](https://esphome.io/components/opentherm#configuration-variables)*

opentherm_version_controller.docs:
**float**: Version of OpenTherm implemented by controller

*See also: [OpenTherm](https://esphome.io/components/opentherm#configuration-variables)*

out_pin.docs:
**number**: The pin of the OpenTherm hardware bridge which is usually labeled `in` on the board.

*See also: [OpenTherm](https://esphome.io/components/opentherm#configuration-variables)*

sync_mode.docs:
**boolean**: Synchronous communication mode prevents other components from disabling interrupts while we are talking to the boiler. Enable if you experience a lot of random intermittent invalid response errors (very likely to happen while using Dallas temperature sensors).

*See also: [OpenTherm](https://esphome.io/components/opentherm#configuration-variables)*
